exposure: Doppler changes in uterine, umbilical, and middle cerebral arteries
cohort: 100 patients presenting with oligohydramnios above 32 weeks of gestation at Government Kilpauk Medical College Hospital, Chennai, from March 2020 to September 2020.
finding: There was a statistically significant association between Doppler changes and maternal complications, period of gestation, neonatal morbidity, low APGAR at birth, and neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: 60% of participants underwent lower segment caesarean section.
